built_name: Ezekiel 40: gates, courts and priestly rooms
built_copy: Old Testament — In the twenty-fifth year of the captivity, fourteen years after the city’s fall, Ezekiel is brought in vision to a high mountain in Israel. A measuring guide surveys the east, north and south gates, the courts, chambers, tables and priestly rooms. A visionary temple, not measured archaeological remains.

built_name: Ezekiel 41: the house and the most holy place
built_copy: Old Testament — The survey measures the temple, a most holy place twenty cubits square, side rooms on three levels, a building to the west, doors, a wooden altar or table, and palm and cherub ornament. The guide goes inward on his own; his access is kept distinct from Ezekiel’s. The source’s dimensions are kept and no exact reconstruction is drawn.

built_name: Ezekiel 42: priestly chambers and the outer measure
built_copy: Old Testament — Chambers on the north and south hold the offerings and the priests’ changed garments. The outer boundary, separating the sanctuary from the profane place, is measured five hundred reeds on each side in this translation; the reeds are not converted to cubits.

built_name: Ezekiel 43:1–17: the glory returns; the altar
built_copy: Old Testament — The glory of God returns from the east through the gate and fills the house; the altar’s stepped measurements follow. A visionary pattern, not a verified construction or date.

built_name: Ezekiel 44:1–5: the shut outer east gate
built_copy: Old Testament — The outer east gate stays shut because the Lord has entered by it; the prince may sit in it to eat bread before the Lord. Ezekiel is then brought by way of the north gate before the house. The gate is not identified with any present-day Jerusalem gate.

Old Testament — Separate places are shown where the priests boil and bake the offerings, and, in the corners of the outer court, where the ministers of the house boil the people’s sacrifices. In this chapter the inner east gate opens on Sabbaths and new moons; it is distinct from chapter 44’s shut outer gate.
